output.title: RAG support assistant
output.description: Changed docs are chunked and embedded into a vector index; questions retrieve context for an LLM, and ratings feed an eval loop.

simulations.title: Launch day questions
simulations.description: Questions climb to 40 a second after a product launch; a quarter of answers are rated and graded.

traffic.label: Questions ramp from 5 to 40 a second

action.text: Each question checks the semantic cache, retrieves the closest chunks from the vector index, and sends them to the LLM as context.
Generation is the slow step, about two seconds. Plenty of requests in flight keeps throughput up while each answer streams.
About a quarter of answers get a rating. An eval job asks the LLM to grade them for groundedness, and the scores feed a dashboard.

simulations.title: Re-index the knowledge base
simulations.description: A docs migration changes 1,200 pages at once; the ingest queue absorbs them while questions are still answered.

action.text: A docs migration touches 1,200 pages at once. The queue takes them all; four workers embed about 80 pages a second. Each dot is four messages.
Questions are still answered while the backlog drains. The index gets fresher page by page.
The queue is empty and every page is re-embedded. Nothing was lost, even though the burst outran the workers.
